title: Evaluate Brave Answers endpoint for native-style grounded answers
description: Brave ships an OpenAI-compatible Answers plan (per AIMultiple May 2026 pricing: $4 per 1K requests plus $5 per 1M input/output tokens, 2 queries/second, streaming, citation-supported grounding, OpenAI SDK compatible; verify against brave.com/search/api current docs before starting). It could ride the native grounding infrastructure like the Parallel Responses idea (executeGroundedSearch + NATIVE_REGISTRY row), giving Brave-synthesized answers with citations. Open questions: (1) billing policy — token-metered answers differ from Brave's free-tier search path, so the existing BRAVE_API_KEY free-mode admission gates must not silently cover it; it needs its own explicit opt-in; (2) whether BRAVE_API_KEY works for the Answers endpoint or a separate subscription key is required; (3) how synthesized answers interact with Brave's role as the conservative last-resort keyword path (DESIGN.md) — answers may justify a different routing position than search; (4) contract smoke with live credentials once scoped. User direction 2026-09-06: not wanted now; task exists so the option is tracked. Prerequisite before any work: verify current Brave Answers API surface and pricing against official docs (vendor pricing moves fast).

logs.msg: Created from 2026-09-06 provider round: user declined implementation now, wants the option tracked. Do not start without explicit user direction; verify current API surface against official Brave docs first.
